# 00000003829

**RC-09 ★** — source: 113_表示论的组合侧_晶体与幺半群.md

**English.** Definition: The core-partition crystal B_{s,t} denotes the graph on (s,t)-core partitions generated by adding and removing borders. Conjecture: When gcd(s,t)=1, the number of connected components of B_{s,t} is the rational Catalan number (1/(s+t))·C(s+t,s); in general it equals that number times an explicit correction factor in gcd(s,t). (core crystal component formula)

**中文。** 定义：核分拆晶体 B_{s,t} 指 (s,t)-核分拆集上由加边与去边生成的图。猜想：gcd(s,t)=1 时 B_{s,t} 的连通分量个数为有理 Catalan 数 1/(s+t)·C(s+t,s);一般情形等于该数乘以 gcd(s,t) 的显式修正因子。（核晶体分量公式）
